definitions.gloss: canned salmon; a can of salmon
definitions.explanation: Salmon preserved in a can. A common pantry staple used in rice dishes, salads, and sandwiches; also read さけかん or しゃけかん.

examples.japanese: {鮭缶|さけかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: To open a can of salmon.

examples.japanese: {鮭缶|さけかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}→炊き込みご飯：05883_takikomigohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I make seasoned rice using canned salmon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、{鮭缶|さけかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{買|か}い{置|お}き→買い置き：30297_kaioki⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I keep a few cans of salmon stocked in case of a disaster.

notes:
Contraction of ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧ (salmon) + ⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧ (can). A convenient, long-keeping food often used in home cooking and stockpiled for emergencies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鮭缶|さけかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a can of salmon
- {鮭缶|さけかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汁|しる}→汁：10462_shiru⟧: the liquid in the salmon can

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ツナ{缶|かん}→ツナ缶：26947_tsunakan⟧: canned tuna
- {蟹缶|かにかん}: canned crab
